facts.business: CG-VAK Software and Exports Limited provides software services, including offshore software services, outsourced product development, product engineering, cloud, data analytics, and AI-enabled solutions.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on property, plant and equipment (including capital advances)

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company remains focused on strengthening its position as a preferred technology partner and increasing its investments in Artificial Intelligence (AI), including AI-enabled software development and Agentic AI solutions, while strengthening its capabilities in Outsourced Product Development (OPD), Product Engineering, Cloud and Data Analytics.
guidance_or_targets.value: AI, Agentic AI, OPD, Product Engineering, Cloud, Data Analytics

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company will also make additional investments in sales and marketing, including strengthening its senior sales and business development leadership team, to accelerate customer acquisition and deepen relationships with existing customers.
guidance_or_targets.value: Strengthening senior sales and business development leadership

key_risks: Uncertainties influencing global markets and technology spending
